blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reconstructing audio from brain activity remains challenging. Existing brain-to-audio pipelines typically map neural responses to predefined stimulus representations before synthesis. While recent work in the visual domain has explored direct conditioning on brain activity, this approach has not yet been extended to audio diffusion models. We introduce MAAS (Multi-Area Auditory Synthesis), an end-to-end framework that conditions a pretrained audio diffusion transformer on ROI-wise fMRI responses without first supervising a decoder to predict an external stimulus representation. MAAS uses region-specific projections and learned brain tokens to condition Stable Audio through a dedicated cross-attention pathway. On a 7T fMRI dataset, we demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines, including two-stage fMRI-to-latent conditioning, across both acoustic and semantic evaluation metrics. In addition, we introduce a fidelity metric grounded in a computational model of auditory neural processing, which allows us to quantify the contribution of individual auditory cortical regions to reconstructed audio representations.
blocks.zh: 从大脑活动中重建音频仍然具有挑战性。 现存的脑到声管一般在合成前会绘制神经对预定义的刺激表现的反应图. 虽然最近视觉领域的工作探索了大脑活性的直接条件,但这种方法尚未被推广到音频传播模型. 我们引入了MAAS(多领域审计综合),这是一个端到端的框架,它以预先训练的音频传播变压器为条件,对ROI-wise fMRI的响应不首先监督解码器来预测外部刺激的表示. MAAS利用特定区域的预测和所学的大脑符号,通过专用的交叉注意路径为Stable Audio提供条件。 在一个7T fMRI数据集上,我们显示比基线的一致改进,包括两个阶段的fMRI到纬度调节,包括声学和语义学评价指标。 此外,我们引入了一个基于听觉神经处理计算模型的忠诚度度量标准,它使我们能够量化单个听觉皮层区域对重建音频表达的贡献.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reconstructing audio from functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) measurements of brain activity offers a unique window into the representational structure of auditory cortex, yet remains technically challenging. While recent advances in the visual domain have demonstrated that photorealistic images can be synthesized from fMRI ( Ferrante et al., 2024a ; Ozcelik and VanRullen, 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) , progress in the auditory domain has been comparatively limited. This gap reflects several compounding factors: the hemodynamic response introduces temporal blurring on the order of seconds ( Kay et al., 2013 ) , auditory datasets with sufficient diversity remain scarce, and sound reconstruction imposes strict spectrotemporal constraints.
blocks.zh: 从功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)的脑活性测量中再造出音频,为听觉皮层的表达结构提供了一个独特的窗口,然而在技术上仍然具有挑战性. 虽然视觉领域的最新进步表明光现实主义图像可以从fMRI中合成(Ferrante等,2024a;Ozcelik和VanRullen等,2023;Luo等,2023;Chen等,2023),但听觉领域的进展相对有限. 这一差距反映了几个复合因素:出血动力反应引入了分秒顺序上的时间模糊(Kay等,2013年),具有足够多样性的听觉数据集仍然稀缺,而声音重建则施加了严格的光谱约束.

blocks.en: Audio generative models impose a restrictive conditioning interface, typically accepting semantic embeddings (e.g., text or audio-language representations). Recent work tried to extend text-conditioned audio generation with additional, non-text conditioning signals. AP-Adapter ( Tsai et al., 2024 ) augments AudioLDM2 ( Liu et al., 2024 ) with a parallel cross-attention pathway, allowing the model to use acoustic information alongside the text prompt for sound editing. MuseControlLite ( Tsai et al., 2025 ) applies decoupled cross-attention to Stable Audio ( Evans et al., 2025 ) to incorporate time-varying musical attributes, such as melody, rhythm, and dynamics, as well as reference-audio signals, enabling temporally controlled generation and audio inpainting or outpainting.
blocks.zh: 音频基因模型强制使用限制性条件界面,一般接受语义嵌入(如文本或音频语言表达). 最近的工作试图以额外的,非文本调制信号来扩展文本条件的音频生成. AP-Adapter (Tsai等人, 2024年) 增强 AudioLDM2(Liu等,2024年)具有平行的交叉注意路径,允许模型在文字提示的同时使用声学信息来进行声音编辑. Muse ControlLite(Tsai等,2025年)对Stable Audio(Evans等,2025年)应用了脱钩的交叉意向来,将旋律,节奏,动态等时断时续的音乐属性以及参考-音频信号相融合而成,使时间控制生成和音频的插画或出画成为可能.

blocks.en: Existing brain-to-audio pipelines address the conditioning mismatch through a two-stage strategy, mapping neural activity onto intermediate deep neural network (DNN) embeddings, such as CLAP ( Elizalde et al., 2023 ) or YamNet ( Hershey et al., 2017 ) , which are then used to guide a generative model. While effective, this approach introduces a key limitation: it constitutes an information bottleneck ( Shirakawa et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) , and reliance on intermediate embeddings may discard fine-grained spectrotemporal structure. Recent work in decoding of visual stimuli from brain activity has begun to explore an alternative paradigm based on direct conditioning, where generative models are conditioned on brain representations without intermediate embedding prediction ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . Related ideas have also been explored in language domain, where neural signals are directly integrated into autoregressive generation ( Ye et al., 2025 ) . However, these approaches are tailored to specific architectures and do not transfer directly to current audio diffusion models.
blocks.zh: 现有的脑到声管通过两相策略解决了调节不匹配的问题,将神经活性映射到中间深神经网络(DNN)嵌入物上,如CLAP(Elizalde等,2023年)或YamNet(Hershey等,2017年),然后用于指导基因模型. 这种方法虽然有效,但引入了一个关键限制:它构成信息瓶颈(Shirakawa等,2025;Feng等,2026),依赖中间嵌入可能会丢弃细纹分光结构. 近期从大脑活性中解码视觉刺激的工作已经开始探索基于直接调节的替代范式,其中基因模型以大脑表现为条件而无需中间嵌入预测(Feng等,2026年). 语言领域也探索了相关想法,其中神经信号被直接融合到自旋生成中(Ye等,2025.). 然而,这些方法是针对具体架构而设计的,并不直接被转移到目前的音频传播模式.

blocks.en: Here, we introduce MAAS (Multi-Area Auditory Synthesis), an end-to-end framework for conditioning a pretrained audio diffusion transformer on ROI-wise fMRI responses. Central to our approach is a transformer-compatible adapter that injects neural representations into the cross-attention layers of a diffusion transformer (DiT), while remaining compatible with pretrained models such as Stable Audio ( Evans et al., 2025 ) . Importantly, MAAS preserves anatomical organization at the region-of-interest (ROI) level by conditioning on ROI-specific representations. This enables an interpretable mapping between brain regions and generated audio, allowing the contribution of distinct cortical areas to be explicitly probed. This is important because different regions of auditory cortex are thought to encode complementary aspects of sound, and separating their contributions helps reveal how complex auditory representations are organized in the brain.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们引入了MAAS(多领域审计合成),这是一个端到端框架,用于在ROI-wise fMRI响应上对一个经过预先训练的音频扩散变压器进行调节. 我们方法的核心是同变压器相兼容的适配器,它将神经表达入扩散变压器(DIT)的相通层中,同时与Stable Audio(Evans等,2025年)等预先训练过的模型保持相容. 重要的是,MAAS在利益区一级保留解剖组织,以ROI的具体表述为条件。 这使得能够在大脑区域之间进行可解释的绘图并生成音频,从而可以明确探究不同皮层区域的贡献。 这一点很重要,因为不同的听觉皮层区域被认为可以编码声音的互补方面,而分离它们的贡献有助于揭示大脑中如何组织复杂的听觉表现.

blocks.en: We instantiate this framework for brain-to-audio reconstruction from fMRI. Early studies demonstrated that spectrotemporal features of natural sounds could be predicted from fMRI patterns using multivariate regression ( Santoro et al., 2017 ) , though resulting reconstructions lacked perceptual fidelity. More recent approaches have improved realism by decoding high-level DNN features and mapping them to a codebook-based audio generator ( Park et al., 2025 ) . Denk et al. (2025) and Ciferri et al. (2025) have pursued decoding of musical stimuli from neural signals, both routing through latent representations before synthesis. In these pipelines, the intermediate representation also serves as a denoising stage, leveraging regularization to suppress measurement noise before synthesis ( Ferrante et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh: 我们从fMRI中即时分析这个脑到脑重建的框架。 早期的研究表明,自然声音的分光时空特征可以通过多变量回归(Santoro等人,2017年)从fMRI模式中预测出,尽管由此产生的重建缺乏知觉忠诚. 较新的方法通过对高级DNN特性进行解码并将其映射到一个基于编码的音频生成器(Park等人,2025年),提高了现实性。 Denk等人(2025年)和Ciferri等人(2025年)对来自神经信号的音乐刺激进行了解码,两者在合成前都通过潜在表达来进行通路. 在这些管道中,中间代表也充当了去诺化阶段,利用规范化在合成前抑制测量噪声(Ferrante等,2024b.) 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: In contrast, our setting leverages the signal-to-noise ratio of fMRI responses acquired at ultra-high magnetic field strength (7 Tesla) ( Santoro et al., 2017 ; Giordano et al., 2023 ) , which exceeds that of conventional field strengths. This enables robust estimation of voxel-wise responses to individual sounds, substantially reducing measurement noise.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,我们的设定利用了在超高磁场强度(7 Tesla)(Santoro等人,2017年;Giordano等人,2023年)中获得的fMRI响应的信号-噪声比,超过了常规场强度. 这使得能够对单个声音的活性反应进行有力的估计,并大大减少测量噪音。

blocks.en: MAAS reconstructs natural sounds from fMRI with improved acoustic and semantic fidelity. The structured ROI-based conditioning enables analysis of the representational contribution of individual cortical regions via an ablation-based fidelity metric computed in a biologically grounded auditory representation space. We further characterize how brain-derived signals are guided through the generative process via attention routing.
blocks.zh: MAAS用改进的声学和语义忠诚来重建来自fMRI的自然声音. 结构化的基于ROI的调制使得能够通过一个基于生物的听觉代表空间所计算的基于阴阳的忠诚度度量来分析单个皮层区域的代表性贡献。 我们进一步描述脑源信号如何通过注意力的分泌过程引导。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (i) an end-to-end framework for conditioning a pretrained audio diffusion transformer on ROI-wise fMRI responses, without an intermediate decoder trained to predict a predefined stimulus representation; (ii) an evaluation on a 7T dataset, including controlled two-stage and caption-based baselines, and a neural-information controls; (iii) an analysis of ROI-level perceptual contributions using a biologically grounded auditory representation.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(一) 在ROI-wise fMRI反应上为预先训练的音频传播变压器配置一个端到端框架,没有经过中间解码器培训,以预测预先界定的刺激表示;(二) 对7T数据集进行评价,包括有控制的两阶段基线和基于标题的基线,以及神经信息控制;(三) 利用基于生物的听觉表示分析ROI水平的认知贡献。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent work has shown that perceptual stimuli can be reconstructed from fMRI by conditioning generative models on features decoded from brain activity. In vision, latent diffusion models combined with DNN feature decoding (e.g., CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , DINO ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) ) have enabled high-quality image reconstruction ( Ferrante et al., 2024a ; Takagi and Nishimoto, 2023 ; Scotti et al., 2024 ) . In the auditory domain, early work decoded spectrotemporal features directly ( Santoro et al., 2017 ) , while more recent approaches using audio-AI models have similarly relied on intermediate representations to drive generative models ( Park et al., 2025 ; Denk et al., 2025 ; Ciferri et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, our approach removes this intermediate stage by directly conditioning the generative model on neural signals.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作表明,通过在从脑活性解码的特征上对基因模型进行调节,可以从fMRI中重建知觉刺激. 在视觉中,与DNN特征解码结合的潜在扩散模型(如CLIP(Radford等,2021年),DINO(Oquab等,2023年))使得能进行高质量的图像重建(Ferrante等,2024a;高木和西本,2023;Scotti等,2024年). 在听觉领域,早期的工作直接解码了光谱时态特征(Santoro等人,2017年),而使用音频-AI模型的更近期的方法同样依赖中间表示来驱动基因模型(Park等人,2025年;Denk等人,2025年;Ciferri等人,2025年)。 相比之下,我们的方法通过在神经信号上直接调节基因模型来去除这个中间阶段.

blocks.en: A small number of recent works have explored conditioning generative models directly on brain activity. NeuroAdapter ( Feng et al., 2026 ) conditions a visual latent diffusion model, based on a UNet architecture ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , on parcellated fMRI representations bypassing intermediate feature spaces. Our work extends this paradigm to audio diffusion transformers, which differ in architecture and conditioning interfaces.
blocks.zh: 少数近期的作品探索了直接针对大脑活性进行基因调控的模式. NeuroAdapter(Feng等,2026年)以UNet架构(Rombach等,2022年)为基础,在绕过中间地物空间的被包裹的fMRI表示上,为视觉潜在扩散模型提供了条件. 我们的工作将这个范式扩展到了音频传播变压器,这些变压器在架构和调制接口上有所不同.

blocks.en: Several methods have been proposed to incorporate auxiliary inputs into diffusion models. IP-Adapter ( Ye et al., 2023 ) introduces a lightweight mechanism for injecting external representations into cross-attention layers via key-value modulation, enabling flexible conditioning beyond text. AP-Adapter and MuseControlLite ( Tsai et al., 2025 ) extend text-conditioned audio generation by incorporating reference-audio features or time-varying musical controls via decoupled cross-attention. We extend the adapter concept to diffusion transformer (DiT)–based audio models, enabling conditioning on continuous signals such as fMRI.
blocks.zh: 提出了若干方法,以便将辅助投入纳入传播模式。 IP-Adapter(Ye等人,2023年)引入了一种轻量级机制,通过键值调制,将外表表示注入到交叉意向层中来,使得文字以外的灵活调节成为可能. AP-Adapter和Muse ControlLite(Tsai等,2025年)通过分解的交叉注意力,将参考-Audio特性或时间变化的音乐控制相加,扩展了有文字条件的音频生成. 我们把适配器的概念扩展至以扩散变压器(DIT)为主的音频模型,对fMRI等连续信号进行调制.

blocks.en: While prior decoding work focuses primarily on reconstruction quality, fewer studies address how different brain regions contribute to the generated outputs ( Santoro et al., 2017 ) . By conditioning on ROI–specific signals, our framework enables direct analysis of regional contributions through ablation, providing a more interpretable link between neural activity and generated audio.
blocks.zh: 虽然先前的编解码工作主要侧重于重建质量,但针对不同大脑区域如何为所生成的产出做出贡献的研究较少(Santoro等,2017年)。 通过对ROI特定信号的调制,我们的框架能够通过通化直接分析区域贡献,在神经活性和所生成的音频之间提供更可解释的联系。

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We use the 7T fMRI dataset from Santoro et al. (2017) ; Giordano et al. (2023) . Five participants listened to 288 natural sounds (1 s duration each, divided into four non-overlapping sets of 72 sounds each) spanning six semantic categories (human non-speech vocalizations, speech, animal cries, musical instruments, nature scenes, and tool sounds) while fMRI data were acquired using a clustered EPI sequence (TR = 2600 ms, TA = 1200 ms, TE = 19 ms, voxel size = 1.5 mm isotropic, 7T Siemens). Stimuli were presented in the silent gap between volume acquisitions in a fast event-related design. Each sound was repeated three times across two scanning sessions.
Single-sound BOLD responses were estimated via a two-step procedure a within four-fold cross-validation across the four stimulus sets (3 sets for training, 1 set for testing). First, using the training data, a voxel-specific hemodynamic response function (HRF) was estimated using finite impulse response (FIR) modeling ( Kay et al., 2013 ; Santoro et al., 2014 ) . Second, sound-evoked responses were estimated by fitting fMRI responses, separately for training and test data, using the estimated HRFs and regularised linear regression (ridge). This procedure yields one response estimate (beta) per sound per voxel. Combined with the high functional contrast-to-noise ratio of 7T fMRI, this procedure provides a robust representation of auditory cortical activity ( Santoro et al., 2017 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们使用了来自Santoro等人(2017年)的7T fMRI数据集;Giordano等人(2023年). 5名与会者听取了288个自然声音(每个持续时间为1个,分为4个不相重叠的组合,每组72个声音),涉及6个语义类别(人类非语音声学、语音、动物叫声、乐器、自然场景和工具声音),而fMRI数据则使用组合式的EPI序列(TR = 2600 ms,TA = 1200 ms,TE = 19 ms,voxel = 1.5 mm等同位素,7T Siemens)来获取. 在与事件有关的快速设计中,批量收购之间的无声空白中呈现出刺激. 每个声音在两次扫描中重复了三次。
单一声波BOLD反应通过两步程序进行估计,在四套刺激措施(培训3套,测试1套)的四倍内进行交叉验证。 首先,利用培训数据,采用有限度冲动反应模型估算出一种有氧异能反应功能(Kay等,2013年;Santoro等,2014年)。 其次,通过将fMRI的回复分别用于培训和测试数据,使用估计的HRF和正规化线性回归(脊),对声音偏移的回复进行了估算。 这一程序得出每个毒液每个声音一个响应估计数(β)。 这一程序与7T fMRI的高功能对比-噪声比相结合,为听觉皮层活性提供了有力的体现(Santoro等,2017.

blocks.en:
For each participant, responses were extracted from six bilateral (left and right hemispheres combined) anatomical ROIs covering the auditory cortex: Heschl’s Gyrus (HG), Planum Temporale (PT), Planum Polare (PP), and posterior, middle, and anterior Superior Temporal Gyrus (pSTG, mSTG, aSTG). Each ROI was manually delineated on individual cortical surfaces in the original study.
The final input to MAAS is a matrix 𝐗 ∈ ℝ R × V \mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{R\times V} per sample, where R = 6 R=6 is the number of ROIs and V = 1024 V=1024 is the number of selected voxels per ROI (see below).
blocks.zh:
对于每个参与者,从涵盖听觉皮层的六个双边(左半球和右半球结合)解剖ROI中提取了答复:Heschl的Gyrus(HG)、Planum Temporale(PT)、Planum Polare(PP)和后期、中后期和前期高温Gyrus(pSTG、mSTG、aSTG)。 在最初的研究中,每个ROI都是在单个皮层表面人工划定的.
MAAS的最终输入是矩阵 X Q r × 五、结 论 \ mathbf\in\ mathbb{ R} (中文(简体) ). R\times V}每个样本,其中R=6 R=6为ROI数,而V=1024 V=1024为每个ROI所选择的活塞数(见下文).

blocks.en: Since the number of voxels per ROI differs across participants, direct pooling across subjects is not possible. We address this by selecting the V = 1024 V=1024 most responsive voxels per ROI per participant, quantified as the prediction accuracy (Pearson r r ) of a ridge regression encoding model trained to predict voxel responses from YamNet embeddings ( Hershey et al., 2017 ) , fitted exclusively on the training split (in cross-validation) of each fold to avoid circularity. This yields fixed-dimensional ROI representations that can be pooled across participants and fed jointly to MAAS, with the first module (Projector) learning shared weights across subjects. Note that YamNet serves solely as a voxel selection criterion, not as a conditioning signal for generation.
blocks.zh: 由于参与者之间每份ROI的花瓶数量不同,因此无法直接汇集各科目。 我们通过选择每个参与者每个ROI最能反应的V = 1024 V = 1024 V 最能反应的Voxels, 量化为经培训预测从YamNet嵌入物(Hershey等,2017年)中产生的Voxel响应的山脊回归编码模型的预测精度(Pearson r r),该模型专门安装在每叠的训练分(交叉验证)上,以避免循环. 这就产生了固定维度的ROI表述,可以在参与者之间汇集,并联合提供给MAAS,第一个模块(项目员)学习各科目的共享权重。 注意:YamNet仅作为Voxel选择标准,而不是用于生成的调节信号.

blocks.en: 3.2 Generative Backbone: Stable Audio
blocks.zh: 3.2 基因回骨:稳定音频

blocks.en: We build on Stable Audio ( Evans et al., 2025 ) , a latent diffusion model designed for text-conditioned audio synthesis. The model operates in a compressed latent space obtained via a variational autoencoder (VAE), which maps waveforms 𝐰 ∈ ℝ 1 × T w \mathbf{w}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times T_{w}} to latent representations 𝐳 = ℰ ⁡ ( 𝐰 ) ∈ ℝ C × T z , \mathbf{z}=\mathcal{E}(\mathbf{w})\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times T_{z}}, where C C is the number of latent channels and T z T_{z} is the temporal length of the latent sequence. A Diffusion Transformer (DiT) performs iterative denoising in this latent space, conditioned on textual inputs encoded by the flan T5 model ( Chung et al., 2024 ) . The resulting conditioning sequence 𝐜 text ∈ ℝ L × D \mathbf{c}_{\text{text}}\in\mathbb{R}^{L\times D} (with L = 128 L=128 token length, D = 768 D=768 feature dimension) is injected via cross-attention layers, while duration information is provided through global conditioning embeddings.
blocks.zh: 我们以Stable Audio(Evans等,2025年)为基础,这是一种潜在的传播模型,用于文字条件音频合成。 该模型在通过可变自编码器(VAE)获得的压缩潜入空间中运行,可将波形w → R 1 → T → mathbf{w\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ T z,\ mathbf{\ mathcal{E}(\mathbf{w})\in\mathbb{R\C\times T_{z}},其中C是潜入通道的数量;而Tz T_{z}是潜入序列的时间长度. 扩散变形器(DIT)在这个潜在的空间中进行迭代去诺,以由flan T5模型编码的文字输入为条件(Chung等人,2024年)。 由此而来的条件序列 c 的文本 → R L → D\ mathbf{ c\\ text{ text\in\ mathbb{ R\L\times D} (有 L = 128 L = 128 令牌长度, D = 768 D = 768 特征维度)通过跨心层注入,而持续时间信息则通过全局条件嵌入来提供.

blocks.en: A key limitation of Stable Audio, and audio diffusion models more broadly, is that conditioning is restricted to text embeddings. The architecture does not provide a native mechanism for incorporating structured, non-linguistic signals such as neural activity. While auxiliary conditioning methods have been explored in image diffusion models (e.g., NeuroAdapter ( Feng et al., 2026 ) ), these approaches are tightly coupled to UNet-based architectures ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) and do not transfer directly to transformer-based diffusion backbones. In particular, Stable Audio’s DiT departs from UNet-based designs in several key aspects: it applies rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) ( Su et al., 2024 ) only to latent self-attention queries, uses grouped-query attention (GQA) ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) with fewer key/value than query heads, and exposes conditioning solely as token-level cross-attention rather than spatial feature maps. These choices break the assumptions of UNet-oriented adapters such as IP-Adapter, which rely on spatial attention blocks and matched key-value head structure. Direct reuse is therefore non-trivial: non-text tokens must be separated from text tokens, projected with compatible key/value heads, and routed without disrupting the pretrained denoising interface. MAAS addresses this gap with a dedicated brain pathway for DiT cross-attention.
blocks.zh: 更广义地说,稳定音频和音频传播模型的一个关键限制是,限定仅限于文本嵌入. 该架构没有为融合神经活性等结构化的非语言信号提供本土机制. 虽然在图像传播模型(如NeuroAdapter (Feng等,2026年))中探索了辅助调节方法,但这些方法与基于UNet的架构紧密结合(Rombach等,2022年),不直接转移到基于变压器的传播骨干上. 特别是,Stable Audio的DiT在几个关键方面偏离了UNet的设计:它只将旋转位置嵌入(ROPE)(Su等,2024年)用于潜在的自我注意查询,使用分组-清扫(GQA)(Ainslie等,2023年)的键/值比查询头要少,并暴露出条件纯粹是象征性的交叉注意而不是空间地物图。 这些选择打破了IP-Adapter等面向UNet的适配器的假设,IP-Adapter依赖于空间关注块并匹配了密钥-值头结构. 因此,直接再利用是非三相的:非文本符号必须从文本符号中分离出,以相容的密钥/值头来投放,并且路由不中断预先训练的去诺化接口. MAAS通过专门的DiT交叉注意的大脑路径来弥补这一缺口.

blocks.en: 3.3 MAAS Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.3 MAAS 建筑

blocks.en: Our goal is to map fMRI signals directly into the conditioning space of the generative model, without relying on intermediate embeddings. MAAS comprises three components: (i) a ROI Projector that maps voxel-level activity to a shared embedding space, (ii) a Brain Token Generator that transforms region-wise representations into a compact sequence of conditioning tokens, and (iii) a transformer-compatible adapter that injects these tokens into the diffusion backbone. During training, the standard text pathway is neutralized by providing an empty prompt to the T5 encoder. This ensures that all generative information is conveyed through the brain-derived conditioning stream, enabling a direct analysis of how neural signals influence synthesis.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是将fMRI信号直接映射到基因模型的调节空间中,而不依赖于中间嵌入. MAAS由三个部分组成:(一) 一个ROI投影仪,将阴道平面活度映射到一个共享的嵌入空间;(二) 一个脑托肯生成器,将区域表示转化为紧凑的调节信号序列;以及(三) 一个变压器相容的适配器,将这些信号注入扩散骨干. 在训练期间,标准文本路径通过向T5编码器提供空快取来中和. 这保证了所有基因信息通过脑衍生的调节流来传递,从而能够直接分析神经信号如何影响合成.

Unlike approaches that collapse brain activity into a single global representation, this design preserves region-specific structure and allows the model to learn heterogeneous mappings across anatomically distinct auditory areas.

blocks.en: Adapting this mechanism to a transformer-based diffusion model requires addressing two architectural constraints. First, Stable Audio uses rotary positional embeddings (RoPE), which are applied to queries but not to conditioning keys. To ensure compatibility, both text and brain branches replicate key-value heads via repeat interleaving to match the query head dimensionality before attention computation.

blocks.en: 3.5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.5 评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate reconstruction quality using four complementary metrics. Mel-SSIM and log-mel distance assess acoustic (spectral) fidelity. CLAP similarity measures cosine similarity in the CLAP embedding space ( Elizalde et al., 2023 ) , capturing high-level semantic correspondence between reconstructed and ground-truth audio. Pairwise identification accuracy follows the approach of Park et al. (2025) .
We also compare our results with model baselines. The Brain-to-text baseline predicts flan-T5 text embeddings (obtained with sound captions) from brain activity via ridge regression and conditions the DiT on the resulting estimated sequence, replicating the standard two-stage paradigm. Brain-only passes 𝐂 brain \mathbf{C}_{\text{brain}} directly as the full conditioning sequence in place of the T5 embeddings. Brain-plus-empty adds 𝐂 brain \mathbf{C}_{\text{brain}} as a scaled residual matched to the lambda Adapter on top of the empty-prompt T5 embedding (without the Adapter routing). We also evaluate caption-based conditions. Caption-only conditions Stable Audio on the ground-truth test caption without brain input; this oracle condition measures generation from semantic information unavailable to the brain decoder. Caption-plus-brain (zero-shot) supplies the caption alongside brain tokens to the original MAAS model, which was trained with an empty text prompt.

我们还将结果与示范基线进行比较。 Brain-to-text基线预测Flan-T5文本嵌入(取自声音标题)通过脊回流从大脑活性得到,并给DiT在由此产生的估计序列上设置条件,复制了标准的两级范式. 只脑能直接通过 C 大脑\ mathbf{ C}_{\text{ brain}作为T5嵌入式的全能调节序列. 大脑外加空心 C brain \ mathbf{ C\\ text{ brain}作为缩放的剩余配对器,在空速率 T5 嵌入器上方(没有适配器路由). 我们还评估基于标题的条件。 仅说明条件 在地面-真实测试标题上稳定音频,而不包含大脑输入;这个甲骨文条件衡量从语义信息生成到大脑解码器无法获取. blocks.en: Then we assess neural information over generative prior using two controls. First, MAAS is trained on 30 independently shuffled brain–stimulus assignments per condition, either unrestricted or within category, and evaluated by held-out pairwise identification. Second, ridge regression predicts audio embeddings from each ROI or all ROIs jointly, in a retrieval setting without audio generation ( Ciferri et al., 2026 ) . We report Top-1 and Top-5 retrieval among 72 held-out stimuli; RidgeCV selects alpha from [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000] by internal cross-validation on the training set.
blocks.zh: 然后我们先用两个控制来评估神经信息 而不是基因信息 首先,MAAS接受30个独立洗脑任务的培训,每个条件,无论是不受限制的还是类别内的,都由被搁置的对等识别来评估。 其次,脊回还原预言从每个ROI或所有ROI中,在一个没有音频生成的检索环境中,联合地进行音频嵌入(Ciferri等,2026.). 我们报告Top-1和Top-5在72个被扣出刺激中进行检索;RidgeCV通过内部交叉验证从[0.01,0.1,1,10,100,1000]中选择了α在训练集上.

blocks.en: Finally, to quantify the contribution of individual auditory ROIs, we introduce an ablation-based fidelity metric grounded in a computational model of auditory cortical processing. Reconstructions are processed using the NSL Auditory-Cortical Toolbox ( Chi et al., 2005 ) , which models the transformation of sound along the auditory pathway from the cochlea to primary auditory cortex and produces a multiscale spectro-temporal cortical representation for details. For each sound, an auditory spectrogram was first estimated using 128 cochlear frequency channels, with centre frequencies defined relative to 440 Hz. Spectrotemporal modulation energy was then computed with using 32 temporal modulation rates logarithmically spaced between 1 and 128 Hz and 32 spectral modulation scales logarithmically spaced between 0.2 and 10 cycles/octave. Upward and downward temporal-rate channels were averaged over time and converted to absolute modulation energy, yielding for each sound a 3D representation of size 32 scales × 64 rates × 128 frequency channels (See Appendix A for details). For each test sound, we compute the Pearson correlation r r between the flattened NSL representations of the reconstruction and of the ground truth. blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate MAAS on brain-to-audio reconstruction from fMRI. We first assess reconstruction performance against baselines, then examine qualitative reconstruction behaviour, and finally analyze the contribution of individual auditory cortical regions using our ablation-based fidelity metric.
blocks.zh: 我们从fMRI评估MAAS的脑到脑重建. 我们首先根据基线评估重建业绩,然后审查质地重建行为,最后用我们的忠诚度衡量标准,分析单个听觉皮层区域的贡献。

blocks.en: 4.1 Quantitative Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 定量评价

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports reconstruction performance on the held-out test set (72 sounds per fold), aggregated across four cross-validation folds and participants.
Among brain-conditioning models, MAAS achieved the highest CLAP similarity (0.614), pairwise identification accuracy (85.4%), and Mel-SSIM, while also yielding the lowest log-mel distance. Performance degraded progressively as components of the conditioning mechanism were removed, confirming the importance of both the adapter and backbone fine-tuning, despite routing through a semantically structured embedding space.

在大脑调节模型中,MAAS实现了最高的CLAP相似性(0.614),对偶识别精度(85.4%)和Mel-SSIM,同时也得出了最低的对数-熔相. 由于调制机制的组件被移除,性能逐渐退化,这证实了适应器和主干线微调的重要性,尽管通过结构严密的嵌入空间进行路由调整。

blocks.en: Caption-only conditioning achieves high pairwise identification accuracy, as expected because the oracle caption explicitly provides semantic information. However, it performs substantially worse on both acoustic metrics than MAAS. This suggests that the caption and generative prior can produce a semantically compatible sound but do not recover the stimulus-specific spectrotemporal structure available in the neural responses. Adding captions only at inference to the original MAAS model constitutes an out-of-distribution condition because our model was trained exclusively with an empty prompt. Consistent with this, the zero-shot combination provides no systematic improvement over MAAS.

blocks.en: MAAS produced high-quality sound-reconstructions from fMRI responses. We provide audio examples in the following site: https://fidelioc55.github.io/brainSounds-website/ .

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates the denoising trajectory for two representative test samples. The final reconstructions capture key spectrotemporal characteristics of the ground-truth signals, including harmonic structure in speech and vocalizations and broadband dynamics in environmental sounds. Intermediate denoising steps reveal a structured progression: early steps capture coarse temporal envelopes, while later stages refine spectral detail. This behavior is consistent with the coarse-to-fine nature of diffusion-based generation ( Ho et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 图2显示两个具有代表性的试验样品的去诺轨迹。 最终的重建抓住了地真信号的关键光谱时态特征,包括语音和声学中的谐波结构以及环境声音中的宽带动态. 中间去诺步骤揭示出一种有条理的进展:早期步骤捕捉粗糙的时空信封,而后阶段则细化光谱细节. 这种行为与以扩散为基础的生成的粗糙至细的本质一致(Ho等,2020年).

blocks.en: We further analyzed attention weights during inference. The evolution of ROI-specific attention across denoising steps shows that different cortical regions contribute at different stages of synthesis. In particular, a marked reweighting occurs around steps 60–70, corresponding to the transition from low to high signal-to-noise ratio in the cosine schedule ( Nichol and Dhariwal, 2021 ) . This pattern suggests that the adapter dynamically changes how it routes brain-derived information as generation progresses. See Appendix A for a full description of attention decomposition.
blocks.zh: 我们在推论中进一步分析了注意力的分量。 ROI特定注意力跨越去诺步骤的演变表明,不同的皮层区域在不同合成阶段的贡献. 特别是,在60-70步左右出现了明显的再加权现象,这相当于从低信号到高噪声率在余弦排行表中的过渡(Nichol and Dhariwal, 2021). 这种模式表明,适配器在生成过程中会动态地改变其途径脑源信息的方式. 见附录 A用于完整描述注意力分解.

blocks.en: Importantly, the attention profiles were strongly sound-dependent: different stimuli elicit distinct patterns of ROI weighting throughout the denoising process. This indicates that the contribution of individual cortical regions is not fixed, but adapts to the specific acoustic content of each sound. This observation is consistent with the ROI-level fidelity analysis in Section 4.3 , where different regions contribute differentially across sound categories.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,注意力配置高度依赖声音:不同的刺激引出在整个消音过程中ROI加权的不同模式。 这表明了单个皮层区域的贡献不是固定的,而是适应了每个声音的特定音响内容. 这一意见与第4.3节的ROI级忠诚度分析是一致的,其中不同区域对健全类别的贡献不同。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: MAAS demonstrates that direct conditioning of a latent audio diffusion transformer on fMRI signals is both feasible and advantageous. The consistent performance gains across semantic and perceptual metrics suggest that bypassing intermediate feature prediction preserves information that is otherwise lost in the regression bottleneck, a finding that aligns with recent evidence in the visual domain ( Feng et al., 2026 ) and extends it to the architecturally distinct setting of DiT-based audio generation.
blocks.zh: MAAS表明,在fMRI信号上对潜在的音频扩散变压器进行直接调节既可行又有利。 跨语义和知觉度量的一致性能增益表明,绕过中间特征预测会保存本来在回归瓶颈中丢失的信息,这一发现与视觉领域的最新证据相符合(Feng等,2026年)并被扩展至基于DiT音频生成的建筑上截然不同的设定.

blocks.en: The additional controls suggest that neural conditioning contributes to resolving the acoustic ambiguity inherent in semantic descriptions. A caption can identify a sound source while remaining compatible with many different acoustic realizations. The higher acoustic fidelity obtained with brain conditioning, including when oracle captions are available, suggests that fMRI responses provide constraints that help the generator recover aspects of the particular sound that was heard. The performance reduction under within-category shuffling further supports this interpretation: preserving category correspondence alone does not reproduce the performance obtained with correctly paired neural responses. Together, these findings suggest that MAAS uses neural information beyond broad semantic compatibility to guide the acoustic realization of generated sounds. The trade-off observed under joint caption and brain conditioning also indicates that semantic recognizability and acoustic fidelity capture distinct aspects of reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 附加控制表明神经调节有助于解决语义描述所固有的声学模糊. 一个标题可以识别出一个声音源,同时与许多不同的声学实现保持兼容. 通过大脑调节获得的较高的声学忠心度,包括在有甲骨文标题时,表明fMRI响应提供了制约,有助于生成者恢复所听到的特定声音的某些方面. 类别内洗牌的性能降低进一步支持了这一解释:仅保留类别通信并不能复制用正确配对的神经反应获得的性能. 这些发现共同表明MAAS使用超出广义语义相容性的神经信息来指导所生成的声音的声学实现. 在联合标题和大脑调节下观察到的取舍也表明,语义识别性和声学忠诚性能够捕捉重建的不同方面。

blocks.en: From a technical standpoint, the adapter design addresses a non-trivial compatibility problem: injecting continuous, non-linguistic representations into a model built exclusively around text conditioning, while preserving RoPE asymmetry and GQA structure. The fact that fine-tuning only the cross-attention layers is necessary to achieve strong performance suggests that the generative prior of Stable Audio is preserved, with the brain pathway acting as a targeted guidance.
blocks.zh: 从技术角度看,适配器设计解决了一个非三角相容性问题:将连续的,非语言的表示注入完全围绕文本调制而成的模型中,同时保留了RoPE不对称和GQA结构. 为实现强性能,仅需要微调交叉分层,这一事实表明,稳定音频之前的遗传性得到保留,脑道成为定向指导。

blocks.en: The ablation analysis reveals a hierarchical behaviour that mirrors what is known about the functional organization of the human auditory cortex ( Kell et al., 2018 ; Moerel et al., 2014 ; Rolls et al., 2023 ) : early areas (HG, PT) carry the least redundant and most self-sufficient spectrotemporal information, while higher-order STG regions are largely redundant with them and individually insufficient for faithful reconstruction of non-vocal sounds. This is consistent with evidence that primary auditory cortex responses are largely explained by spectrotemporal modulations ( Santoro et al., 2014 ; Santoro et al., 2017 ) , whereas non-primary regions encode higher-order structure that goes beyond what modulation statistics can capture ( Norman-Haignere and McDermott, 2018 ; Landemard et al., 2021 ) , representations that are categorically informative but perceptually incomplete without the low-level substrate provided by earlier areas. The fact that higher-order regions alone produce the largest fidelity drops suggests that their intermediate acoustic-to-semantic representations ( Giordano et al., 2023 ) , while sufficient for recognition, do not carry enough fine-grained spectro-temporal detail to constrain the generative process toward perceptually faithful synthesis.

blocks.en: Several limitations should be acknowledged. The dataset comprises only five participants and 288 stimuli of 1 second duration, which constrains the generalizability of the reconstruction results. fMRI carries inherent limitations in temporal resolution: the BOLD signal integrates neural activity over several seconds and, with clustered acquisition and GLM-based beta estimation, the input to MAAS reflects a temporally blurred snapshot of auditory cortical processing. That the model achieves the reported reconstruction quality under these constraints is encouraging, and suggests that the spatial pattern of activation across ROIs carries substantial generative information even in the absence of fine-grained temporal dynamics, a hypothesis that could be tested with higher-temporal-resolution modalities. While the attention decomposition provides a mechanistic window into the generative process, the relationship between attention routing and ablation outcomes suggests that the adapter’s internal representations warrant further investigation.
blocks.zh: 应承认若干限制。 数据集仅包括5名参与者和288个第二次期间的刺激,这限制了重建结果的普遍性。 fMRI带有时间分辨率的内在限制: BOLD信号将神经活性融合了数秒,随着集群获取和基于GLM的β估计,对MAAS的输入反映了一个时间上模糊的听觉皮质处理快照. 令人鼓舞的是,模型在这些制约因素下实现了所报告的重建质量,并表明,即使在没有精细的时间动态的情况下,各区域办事处的活化空间模式也含有大量基因信息,这种假说可以用高时分分辨率模式测试。 虽然注意力分解为基因分解过程提供了一个机械的窗口,但注意力去向和膨胀结果之间的关系表明,适应者的内部表述值得进一步调查.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Multi-Area Auditory Synthesis (MAAS), a framework for directly conditioning a latent audio diffusion transformer on fMRI signals. The proposed adapter provides a mechanism for integrating neural representations into DiT-based generative models.
Beyond reconstruction performance, MAAS offers a principled framework for probing the functional contribution of individual auditory cortical regions to sound perception. By conditioning an end-to-end generative model on structured brain representations, our approach enables a generative perspective on cortical information content, complementing traditional encoding and decoding analyses.

我们提出了多地区审计合成(MAAS),这是在fMRI信号上直接为潜在音频扩散变压器进行调节的框架. 拟议适配器为将神经表达法整合入基于DiT的基因模型提供了一种机制.
除了重建业绩外,MAAS还提供了一个原则框架,用以检验单个听觉皮层区域对健全感知的功能贡献. 通过在结构化的大脑表达方式上对端到端基因模型进行修饰,我们的方法能够对皮质信息内容进行基因化视角,补充传统的编码和解码分析.

blocks.en: Looking forward, the direct conditioning paradigm opens several promising directions. In the clinical domain, the ability to reconstruct perceived audio from cortical activity could inform the development of auditory brain-computer interfaces for patients with severe motor impairments or disorders of consciousness, where passive listening paradigms are the only viable option.

blocks.en:
To assess whether the applicability of MAAS extends beyond the original 7T acquisition, we evaluated it on the public 3T dataset of Park et al. [2025] , comprising five independently acquired participants and natural sounds of 8 or 10 seconds. This experiment introduces variation in field strength, stimulus duration, participants, and acquisition protocol, providing an external assessment of the brain-conditioning approach under different measurement conditions. We considered two strategies for estimating stimulus-related fMRI responses. The first followed the delayed-volume averaging procedure of the original study: BOLD volumes were temporally aligned with the stimuli by accounting for the hemodynamic delay (2 seconds), divided into overlapping windows, and then averaged to obtain stimulus-related response patterns. For the second strategy, we estimated stimulus-evoked beta coefficients via GLMsingle [ Prince et al., 2022 ] . Unlike delayed-volume averaging, this approach models the BOLD time series using the experimental design to estimate response amplitudes associated with stimulus presentations. In both strategies we used fMRIprep library [ Esteban et al., 2019 ] to process neural data. The resulting estimates were organized into the same six auditory ROI inputs used by MAAS (HG, PT, PP, mSTG, pSTG, and aSTG). Using stimulus-wise beta representations improves comparability with the neural input format of our 7T experiments, while differences in acquisition
and response-estimation procedures remain.

blocks.en: MAAS achieved pairwise identification accuracies of 83.9 ± 3.8 % 83.9\pm 3.8\% with delayed-volume averaging and 86.1 ± 3.5 % 86.1\pm 3.5\% with GLMsingle. The higher point estimate with GLMsingle suggests that response estimation can affect reconstruction quality, while the performance obtained with both strategies supports the applicability of MAAS across different fMRI input representations. However, Park et al. [2025] identification score uses a different evaluation representation, and their models are subject-specific whereas MAAS uses a cross-subject approach. These values therefore provide contextual benchmarks rather than a controlled comparison of reconstruction methods.
